property_summary: For all callers, only the deployer (the contract owner) can successfully call sudicideAnyone(); the mutant that removes the owner check allows some non-owner caller (fuzzed address) to successfully call sudicideAnyone(), violating this rule.
change_summary: Remove the owner check modifier body so __onlyOwner no longer requires msg.sender == __owner (deleting the require), which allows calls that previously reverted to succeed.
